title: GE Power India Ltd - 532309 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: GE Power India Q2 FY27 revenue rose 11% YoY to INR311 crores, with order intake up 38% to INR331 crores and PBT before exceptionals at INR53 crores.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue reached INR311 crores (up 11% YoY from INR281 crores) and PBT before exceptional items from continuing operations rose to INR53 crores from INR46 crores. Order intake grew 38% YoY to INR331 crores, led by Core services, and backlog stood at INR1,527 crores at 30 September 2026. Key milestones were the INR561 crore Shoaiba Fuel Conversion award in Saudi Arabia and NCLT sanction of the Durgapur demerger to JSW Energy. Management leaned on cash pool lending of INR741 crores and deflected several forward-looking questions.

segments.name: Core services
segments.commentary: Core orders rose to INR232 crores in Q2 FY27 from INR162 crores (+43% YoY). Core sales increased by about INR40 crores YoY in the quarter.

segments.name: Upgrades
segments.commentary: Upgrade sales rose by about INR45 crores YoY in Q2 FY27. Management positions upgrades as the entry point to bring non-GE fleet units into the service base.

segments.name: FGD EPC (legacy)
segments.commentary: About 20% of the INR1,527 crore backlog is FGD EPC, to be executed in subsequent quarters. Management said FGD contributed about 14-15% of Q2 FY27 revenue of INR311 crores.

segments.name: Joint venture (NGSL, 50% with NTPC)
segments.commentary: Management said NGSL posted a loss of about INR5 crores in the quarter, which weighed on consolidated EBITDA versus standalone. NGSL works in O&M, upgrades and retrofits, and is entering solar and BESS.

guidance_outlook: Shoaiba order: INR76 crores booked in Sep 2026 quarter; balance INR485 crores expected to be booked in the December 2026 quarter, with a 2.5-year execution window.
Shoaiba execution is at an early stage; management expects deliveries to start around end-2027 or early 2028.

Durgapur demerger: NCLT sanctioned the scheme; certified order received 13 Oct 2026. Appointed date 1 July 2025. Share entitlement is 10 JSW Energy shares for every 139 GEPIL shares held. Record date to be notified.
Tax: current tax reflects only tax on interest income; management expects a normal tax trajectory about two years out after carry-forward losses are absorbed.
Management declined to give revenue or order book targets, calling them futuristic.
capex_capacity: Shoaiba Fuel Conversion: refurbishment of boiler management, fuel management and firing systems on 9 of 14 boiler units in Saudi Arabia. Scope is EPC equipment supply and field advisory; Dar Al Balad handles erection.
Repair facility at Vadodara announced in May 2026 with capex of about INR18 crores.

Cash pool limit with LM Wind Power Blades India raised to INR1,000 crores after August 2026 AGM approval; outstanding INR741 crores. Management said the current business does not need INR1,000 crores.
Five non-GE fleet refurbishment units under work, with completion running to 2028 per management.
Five-year manufacturing services agreement with JSW Energy for Durgapur supply, alongside work on an alternative supply chain.
demand_pricing: Indian peak demand about 270 GW in Q2 FY27; total generation up 11% YoY to about 536 billion units.
TAM about INR6,500 crores and SAM about INR3,700 crores; GEPIL currently addresses about 21% of SAM.
Non-GE fleet is about 15-17% of current order composition. Management said it has been steadily gaining share in non-GE fleet for about three years.
Management said it has won 100% of RFQs issued so far under the CEA plan for about 66 GW of refurbishment, and is preparing bids for upcoming RFQs.
Strategy is short-cycle work: core projects pay back in 12-15 months and upgrades in about 24 months. Long-gestation EPC is avoided.

qa_highlights.question: What share of service orders and revenue comes from third-party (non-GE) equipment, and what is the 3-year outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Non-GE fleet is about 15-17% of current order composition. Management declined to give a 3-year target and said it is a steady growth focus area.

qa_highlights.question: Why is INR741 crores held in the cash pool, who is the counterparty, and what are the terms?
qa_highlights.answer: Lending is to LM Wind Power Blades India (GE Vernova group cash pool header) at 5.65-6.25%, linked to a one-year government bond rate, repayable on demand and backed by a GE Vernova Inc. parent guarantee. The INR1,000 crore limit was approved at the August 2026 AGM. Management said the business does not need INR1,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Will the order book reach four digits, given CEA refurbishment plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it has won 100% of RFQs so far and is preparing bids. It said timing is market-driven and gave no firm date.

qa_highlights.question: Does NGSL compete with GEPIL, and does GEPIL control its direction?
qa_highlights.answer: NGSL is a 50:50 JV with its own board and management, governed by the AOA and promoters' agreement. Management said it does not compete with GEPIL.

qa_highlights.question: Is Shoaiba margin-accretive, and will quarterly results smooth out?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give project-level margins but said the order is high-margin. It said the strategy is to shift to short-cycle, higher-margin work.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q2 revenue mainly services, or does it include legacy FGD revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 14-15% of the INR311 crore Q2 revenue came from FGD EPC. About 20% of the backlog is FGD and will run into later quarters.

risks_watch: Shoaiba execution and margin disclosure: project margins were not disclosed, and the INR485 crore balance is contingent on advance receipt for December 2026 quarter booking.
Quarterly revenue lumpiness, with about 20% of backlog in legacy FGD EPC that is non-core.
Large cash pool exposure to a related party (INR741 crores), with the parent guarantee as the main protection.
Durgapur demerger completion steps pending; record date not yet notified.
JV NGSL posted a loss of about INR5 crores in the quarter, and management gave limited visibility on its trajectory.
Tax outlook depends on carry-forward losses being absorbed in about two years.
summary.management_tone: Confident on order momentum, Shoaiba and the service strategy. Evasive on forward targets (revenue, order book, non-GE share, project margins), which management repeatedly called futuristic or declined to disclose. Brief, somewhat defensive on the cash pool and NGSL losses.
key_quotes: We have successfully shifted our focus from volume-driven revenue chasing to prioritization of higher-margin, shorter cycle, and cash-accretive opportunities.
Your Company has actually been chosen to contribute towards the Middle East vision of net zero as they are moving further.
The good part on this cash pool arrangement is that the funds are repayable on demand and are also backed up by a parent corporate guarantee, which has been given by GE Vernova Inc.
We have actually decided not to go for the long EPC gestation projects. We want to go for the projects which are short cycle.

adds.what: Vadodara repair facility (capex about INR18 crores, announced May 2026)

growth.why: Management gave no revenue or order-book targets, but Q2 revenue rose 11% YoY and orders rose 38%, with the INR561 crore Shoaiba award (INR485 crore balance due in Dec 2026 quarter) and a 1,527 crore backlog supporting near-term growth; the Vadodara repair facility is the only own-capacity addition, at INR18 crore capex with no stated timeline.

oneOffs.what: Core sales up about INR40 crores YoY and upgrade sales up about INR45 crores YoY in Q2 FY27, against total revenue growth of INR30 crores (INR281 to INR311 crores); the brief does not split the rest o

quality.why: Revenue rose INR30 crores (11%) from INR281 to INR311 crores, with management citing core (+INR40 crores) and upgrade (+INR45 crores) sales growth, which together exceed the total rise, so the brief does not show what offset them; the brief gives no volume or price split and no explicit one-off for Q2, so the growth driver cannot be confirmed.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: PBT before exceptionals rose to INR53 crores from INR46 crores (about 17% YoY) on 11% revenue growth, and management says Shoaiba is high-margin and the strategy is shifting to short-cycle work, but project margins were not disclosed and NGSL is a drag.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Only own-capacity addition is the Vadodara repair facility (about INR18 crores capex, announced May 2026) with no stated commissioning date, and Shoaiba deliveries start only around end-2027 or early 2028, so new capacity is possible but not dated.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Revenue rose 11% YoY to INR311 crores in Q2 and H1 revenue reached INR620 crores vs INR567 crores, with core sales up about INR40 crores and upgrade sales up about INR45 crores YoY, and backlog of INR1,527 crores supports the run-rate.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation figure was disclosed and management said the current business does not need the INR1,000 crore cash pool limit, so no new capex plan is signalled beyond the INR18 crore Vadodara facility.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Order intake rose 38% YoY to INR331 crores and the INR485 crore Shoaiba balance is due in the December 2026 quarter, but management declined to give any revenue or order targets.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: About 20% of the INR1,527 crore backlog is legacy FGD EPC and revenue is lumpy, and NGSL lost about INR5 crores in the quarter, so quarterly delivery shortfalls are a risk even though management gave no formal guidance.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new product, brand or model launch was discussed; the upgrades and core services are existing offerings.

rows.label: Shoaiba balance order booking
rows.why: The INR485 crore balance of the INR561 crore Shoaiba award is expected to be booked in the December 2026 quarter, though management flagged it as contingent on advance receipt.

rows.label: Durgapur demerger to JSW Energy
rows.why: NCLT sanctioned the scheme with a certified order on 13 Oct 2026, and the record date is still to be notified, with 10 JSW Energy shares for every 139 GEPIL shares.

rows.label: Normal tax trajectory
rows.why: Current tax covers only interest income, and management expects a normal tax rate about two years out once carry-forward losses are absorbed, which is beyond the window.

tone.note: Management was confident on order momentum, the Shoaiba award and the service and non-GE strategy, but it was evasive on forward targets and project margins and defensive on the INR741 crore cash pool and NGSL losses.
